hey what is this project about
This project is **SHG**, an interactive and automation-focused CLI for **Capacitor Android development**. It helps developers: - Set up Capacitor and Android platforms - Run apps with live reload over USB, emulator, or Wi‑Fi - Build APKs/AABs - Deploy and sync apps - Manage plugins, assets, versions, and upgrades - Inspect devices and logcat output - Diagnose Android/Java/SDK issues The root project is a **TypeScript/Bun CLI**, while `web/` contains a **React + Vite documentation website**.
